in data gathering, modeling, and preparation for global minimum tax (Pillar 2) reporting requirements Monitor global tax law updates (including BEPS Pillar 2 developments) and prepare tax accounting memos, workpapers, and audit support Assist with modeling the tax provision, compliance, and other operational impacts of tax planning initiatives and M&A activities Partner with Accounting, Treasury, initiatives, and drive continuous process improvements across the tax function with the use of Equifax AI tools What Experience You Need 2-5 years of corporate income tax experience in a multi-entity provision for international operations and transactions Demonstrated experience preparing US international tax forms and disclosures, specifically Forms 1118, 5471, 8858, 8992, 8993, 8991, etc. Strong working knowledge of US international tax compliance and related processes: Net CFC Tested Income (NCTI), formerly GILTI, calculation of foreign tax credit, foreign source income, FDDEI, E&P, tax pools, understanding of FX implications Strong data management skills, including the ability to manage complex datasets, perform reconciliations, and ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial information What Could Set You Apart Proficiency in English and Spanish (bilingual capabilities preferred) Demonstrated experience in identifying and implementing process improvements through the use of technology, data analytics, or AI-enabled tools Strong advanced Excel skills (XLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, Power Query); exposure to Tableau or similar analytics tools is a major advantage CPA preferred
